high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Times of India" website. The headline reads: "Russia calls it 'terror attack'". The article discusses an incident involving attacks on military airfields in the Ivanovo, Ryazan, and Amur Regions, which Russia has labeled as a "terror attack." The statement from Russia claims that all terror attacks were repelled. The article mentions that analysts believe these attacks could be a strategic move by Zelenskyy to increase pressure on Moscow just before the second round of peace talks set to take place on Monday in Istanbul.
